confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for Dambulla, a small Central Province town that serves the Sigiriya and Dambulla Cave Temple tourist circuit. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is less certain because hotel prices vary widely with resort-versus-guesthouse positioning and Sri Lankan tax and service charges. Cocktail and wine_glass are derived from a beer-relative basis (roughly 2.3x and 3.2x the beer anchor) because direct local knowledge of bar prices is weak. The FX observation comes from a search summary citing rba.gov.au; the RBA page itself was not opened and read directly, so verify before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Sri Lankan inland tourist towns on the Cultural Triangle circuit (Sigiriya, Habarana, Kandy outskirts), adjusted for a smaller local market with fewer hostels and a higher share of mid-range guesthouses. Restaurant pricing follows typical tourist-oriented eateries in the region rather than major-city pricing.
